originalAlarm.description: Assigned value is garbage or undefined

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: In prng_seed(16), the while loop runs twice. In the second iteration, i=8, making *((__u64 *)buf+i*8) = *((__u64 *)buf+64), which reads 64 __u64 positions past buf (a 16-byte array holding only 2 __u64 values). The value read from this out-of-bounds location is garbage/undefined, correctly triggering the core.uninitialized.Assign alarm at line 18. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for c708c57e247.c documents exactly this OutOfBoundsRead at the same line and configuration (CONFIG_S390_PRNG enabled). The tool detects the same root cause from the perspective of reading garbage from the out-of-bounds access. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: CONFIG_S390_PRNG==true is correct — prng_seed is only defined and called under this config.
